Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Alex Caruso?

Alex Caruso is 32 years old.

Where was Alex Caruso born?

Alex Caruso was born in College Station, Texas.

When was Alex Caruso born?

Alex Caruso was born on February 28, 1994.

How tall is Alex Caruso?

Alex Caruso is 6-5 (196 cm) tall.

How much does Alex Caruso weigh?

Alex Caruso weighs 186 lbs (84 kg).

Is Alex Caruso in the Hall of Fame?

Alex Caruso is not in the Hall of Fame.

What position does Alex Caruso play?

Point Guard and Shooting Guard.

What is Alex Caruso's net worth?

Alex Caruso has made at least $60,636,651 playing professional basketball.

How much does Alex Caruso make?

Alex Caruso made $18,102,000 in 2026.

How many rings does Alex Caruso have?

Alex Caruso has won 2 championships.

What is Alex Caruso's Instagram account?

Alex Caruso is on Instagram at acfresh21.

What schools did Alex Caruso attend?

Alex Caruso attended A&M Consolidated in College Station, Texas and Texas A&M.

What are Alex Caruso's nicknames?

Bald Mamba, Bald Eagle, Carushow, GOAT, A.C., White Mamba 2.0, The Accountant are nicknames for Alex Caruso.
